title: Moving checklist and timeline builder
description: Build a task list with due dates counted back from moving day, then sort it into a usable timeline.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: moving-checklist
  title: Moving checklist and timeline builder
  description: Build a task list with due dates counted back from moving day, then sort it into a usable timeline.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a clear, dated checklist so nothing about the move is forgotten or left too late.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Move date and household details
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions, including the target move date, household size, and whether movers or a rental truck are involved. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: task-builder
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Move task-list builder
      role: Planner who builds a moving checklist by working backward from the move date.
      prompt: Build a list of moving tasks (e.g., booking movers, transferring utilities, changing address, packing by room, canceling or transferring subscriptions) and assign each a due date by counting backward from the given move date. Group tasks into rough timeframes such as eight weeks out, two weeks out, moving week, and moving day. Flag any task that seems time-sensitive given the stated move date.
      capabilities: { skills: [operations-planning], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        properties:
          tasks:
            type: array
            items:
              type: object
              properties:
                task: { type: string }
                dueDate: { type: string }
                category: { type: string }
    - id: sorted
      kind: transform
      name: Sort tasks into a timeline
      config: { operation: sort, expression: "sort tasks ascending by dueDate" }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Dated moving checklist
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: task-builder, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: task-builder, to: sorted, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: sorted, to: result, kind: data }
